photos.title: Woman with a floral headdress
photos.caption: Portrait of a woman wearing a crown and garland of flowers over a patterned veil.
photos.note: Probably the wife of Mirza Nazim Ghaffary (thesis F26/F27). Confirm before publishing an ID.

photos.title: Seated woman with a water pipe
photos.caption: A woman in flowered dress and patterned veil sits on cushions beside a water pipe.

photos.title: Woman and child in a courtyard
photos.caption: A veiled woman stands with a small child under a covered gallery.

photos.title: Open-air performance before a crowd
photos.caption: A large audience sits in a circle around performers and a drummer in a walled courtyard.

photos.title: Family at the wall of a house
photos.caption: A father, a mother and three boys pose in front of a lattice window.

photos.title: Young woman with long braids
photos.caption: Portrait of a young woman in a white headscarf with two long braids.

photos.title: A man, two women and a child
photos.caption: A man in a long coat stands behind two seated women in flowered headdresses and a sleeping child.
photos.note: Probably F03, Mirza Nazim Ghaffary and his wives.

photos.title: Group of veiled women
photos.caption: A line of women in dark robes and face veils stands in a sunlit courtyard.
photos.note: Possibly F40, Saint Catherine sisters, Djoulfa.

photos.title: Two children in festive dress
photos.caption: Two children in embroidered clothes sit together with a bunch of flowers.
photos.note: Possibly F11, niece and nephew of the Shah.

photos.title: Veiled woman in profile
photos.caption: Portrait of a young woman in a light veil, looking to the side.

photos.title: Young man in a long coat
photos.caption: A young man in a cap and buttoned coat stands beside a garden wall and stream.

photos.title: Woman with a water jar
photos.caption: A woman in a printed skirt and headscarf holds a copper water vessel in a courtyard.
